title: Build a Routine
coreMove: Routine is not rigidity; it is a stabilizing rhythm that pre-decides small starts, lowers mental load, and leaves attention free for work, rest, and judgment.

exampleSpecs.audience: people waiting for the right mood before a small start
exampleSpecs.stakes: show routine putting the person where work can find them
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Petra starts the same reset at nine before inspiration can argue

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose tiny choices keep stealing morning judgment
exampleSpecs.stakes: show a routine card lowering cognitive load
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Margo's checklist improves because it pre-decides the opening sequence

exampleSpecs.audience: people reinventing the same setup every morning
exampleSpecs.stakes: notice the energy leak before it becomes normal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Luis catches needless reinvention while it is happening

exampleSpecs.audience: teams who need a written first move
exampleSpecs.stakes: make the first action visible before searching spends the morning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Farah turns a repeated packet setup into a standing rule

exampleSpecs.audience: people using routine to keep shared process from heating up
exampleSpecs.stakes: show order as a safety net for disagreement and work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Anika's visible order steadies the band while Keon's improvising heats it

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need a routine to begin difficult creative work
exampleSpecs.stakes: reframe repetition as a rail rather than a cage
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Rae accepts the same opening sequence as support for the hard part
